Taha.
Asiyembulelanga iKurani kuwe [Muhamadi] ukuze uthole ubunzima.
Ngaphandle nje kokuthi ibe isikhumbuzo kulowo owesabayo [u Allah].
Yehle kancane kancane ivela kulowo odale umhlaba namazulu aphakeme.
Onomusa wenyukela eSihlalweni.
Konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni nokumaphakathi kwawo nokungaphansi komhlaba kungokuka Allah.
Noma ungakhulumela phezulu, nembala u Allah wazi okuyimfihlo nokusithele.
U Allah akekho omunye ofanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaKhe, unaMagama amahle.
Ingabe usuyitholile indaba kaMusa na?
Mhla ebona umlilo wathi kumndeni wakhe: “Hlalani la, ngibona umlilo hleze nginiphathele isikhuni esivuthayo noma ngithole ongangilayela indlela emlilweni”.
Kuthe lapho efika kuwo wamenyezwa; “We Musa”.
Nebala Yimina Lona iNkosi yakho. Ngakhoke khumula izimbadada zakho ngokuba usesigodini saseTuwa esihlanzekile.
Futhi sengikuhlonzile ngakhoke lalela lokho okwembulwayo.
Impela Yimina lona u Allah, akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kwaMi. Ngakhoke khonza Mina [kuphela] wenze neswala ukuze ungikhumbule.
Nembala iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] siyeza, ngithi angingasigaguli ukuze wonke umphefumulo uzuziswe ngalokho okwenzile.
Ngakhoke akungabi bikho muntu ongakholwa yiso nolandela izinkanuko ozokugudlula [ekukholweni] kuso, funa ubhubhe.
Yini lokhu okusesandleni sakho sokudla we Musa?
Wathi: “Induku yami, ngidondoloza ngayo ngiphinde ngephulele imfuyo yami amagatsha ngayo kantike ziningi ezinye izinto engisiza ngazo”.
Wathi [u Allah]: “Ijikijele phansi we Musa”.
Wayijikijela phansi, maqede yaba inyoka ihuhuluza.
Wathi: “Ithathe ungesabi, sizoyibuyisela esimeni sayo sasekuqaleni”.
Futhi faka isandla sakho ohlangothini lwakho [ngaphansi kwengalo], sizophuma sesimhlophe okungekona okokugula; isibonakaliso nje esinye.
Ukuze sikubonise ezinye zezibonakaliso zeThu ezinkulu.
Hamba uye kuFirawuni ngokuba impela usephule umthetho.
Wathi [uMusa]: “Nkosi yami ngivulele inhliziyo yami”.
Wenze izinto zami zibe lula.
Uqaqe lelifindo elisolwimini lwami.
Ukuze bayiqondisise inkulumo yami.
Ungiqokele isekela elivela emndenini wami.
uHaruna umnewethu.
Ngimise ngaye isibindi.
Futhi umbandakanye odabeni lwami.
Ukuze sikubabaze kakhulu.
Futhi sikukhumbule kakhulu.
Nembala wena uhlezi usibona.
Wathi [u Allah]: “Usukunikiwe lokhu okucelile we Musa”.
Sesiphinde sakubusisa futhi.
Khumbula mhla siyalela unyoko lokho okwayalelwa.

Ukuthi: “Mfake ebhokisini ulitshingele emfuleni. Umfula uyomkhafulela osebeni, athathwe yisitha saMi naye [uFirawuni]”. Futhi ngakuthela ngothando oluvela kiMi nokuthi wakhuliswa ngaphambi kwaMehlo Ami.

Mhla udadewenu ehamba [eya kuFirawuni] wathi: “Kunganjani nginitshengise ongakhona ukumnakekela na?”. Sakubuyisela kunyoko ukuze athokoze angakhathazeki. Futhi wabulala umuntu, sakuhlenga osizini saphinde sakuvivinya ngezivivinyo eziningi. Wabe usuhlala esizweni saseMadiyana iminyaka wase usufikela lapho onqunyelwe ukuba ube khona we Musa.
Ngase ngizikhethela wena.
Hambake wena nomfowenu nezibonakaliso zami ningaphezi ukungikhumbula.
Hambani nobabili niye kuFirawuni, impela usephule umthetho ngokwedlulele.
Nobabili nikhulume naye amazwi amnene hleze alalele noma esabe [u Allah].
Bobabili bathi: “Nkosi yethu, impela sesaba ukuthi uyosijezisa noma adaze inkani”.
Wathi [u Allah]: “Ningesabi ngokuba Mina nginani nobabili, ngilalele futhi ngiyabona”.

Iyani kuye nobabili nifike nithi: “Thina siyiZithunywa zeNkosi yakho. Ngakhoke dedela isizwe sakwa Isirayelikithi futhi ungasijezisi. Futhi size nesibonakaliso esivela eNkosini yakho. Ukuthula makube kulowo olandelela indlela yeqiniso”.
Nembala kwembulelwe kithi ukuthi isijeziso siyotholwa yilowo ongakholwa aphinde anganaki.
Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Ubani iNkosi yenu nobabili na, we Musa?”.
Wathi: “iNkosi yethu yilena eyepha yonke into umlingani wayo wase eyihola [kulokho ekudingayo]”.
Wathi: “Pho kwakuyini inkinga yezizwe zasendulo”.
Wathi: “iNkosi yami enolwazi ngabo lulotshiwe eNcwadini, phela iNkosi yami ayilenzi iphutha futhi ayikhohlwa”.
Lena eyenze umhlaba waba wandlaleka wanidabulela kuwo izindlela. Waphinda wehlisa amanzi emvula wanikhiqizela ngawo izitshalo ezahlukene ngambili.
Dlanini nidlise nemfuyo yenu. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abanogebhezi olubhandlile.
Sinidale ngawo [ngenhlabathi umhlaba] futhi siyonibuyisela kuwo [mhla ningcwatshwa] siphinde sinikhiphe kuwo futhi okwesibili [mhla sinivuswa].
Sambonisa [uFirawuni] izibonakaliso zeThu zonke kepha wangakholwa futhi wenqaba.
Wathi [uFirawuni]: “We Musa, ingabe uze kithi ukuze usikhiphe endaweni yethu ngobuthakathi bakho na?”
Ngakhoke nathi sizokuhlangabeza ngomlingo ofanayo. Beka-ke isikhathi sokuhlangana phakathi kwethu esisosigcina thina nawe, indawo ephakathi nendawo.
Wathi [uMusa]: “Isikhathi senu sokuhlangana, usuku lwemvunulo futhi kumele abantu bathuniswe emini yasekuseni”.
Kepha uFirawuni wakushaya indiva [umlayezo ka Musa]. Wamane wahlanganisa itulo lakhe weza.
Wathi kubo uMusa: “Qaphelani, ningalinge niqambele u Allah amanga funa anibhubhise ngesijeziso. Futhi akazuzi lutho lowo oqamba amanga.
Baphikisana bodwa ngodaba lwabo futhi babhunga ngasese.
Bathi: “Nembala, laba bobabili abalumbi; bafuna ukunikhipha endaweni yenu ngemilingo yabo baphinde baniphuce usiko lwenu olusezingeni.
Ngakhoke, hlanganisani isu lenu bese nima imigqa. Uyohlabana namhlanje lowo oyodla ubhedu.
Bathi: “Musa, ungajikijela noma kube yithi esijikijela kuqala”.
Wathi: “Cha jikijelani nina”. Kwaba usebona izintambo zabo nezinduku zabo ongathi ziyahamba ngenxa yomlingo wabo.
Wazizwa uMusa engenwa itwetwe.
Sathi: “Ungesabi ngokuba nguwena oyodla ubhedu [ozonqoba]”.
Jikijela lokho okusesandleni sakho sokudla, kuyogwinya konke lokhu abakwenzile. Phela lokhu abakwkenzile itulo nje lomlumbi; futhi akukho lapho umlumbi aphumelela khona.
Abalumbi bawa ngobuso bekhothama, bathi: “Siyakholelwa eNkosini kaHaruni noMusa”.

Wathi [uFirawuni]: “Nimkholwa kanjani ngingakaniphi imvumo na? Okusho ukuthi nguyena impela ubongoza wenu onifundise umlingo. Ngizonigenca izandla nemilenze ngokuphambana bese nginibethelela eziqwini zamasundu; niyokwazi-ke ukuthi ngubani phakathi kwethu onesijeziso esinzima nesiyohlala sikhona”.
Bathi [abalumbi]: “Asisoze sakhetha wena kuna lezibonakaliso ezifike kithi naloyo osidalile. Yehlulela okwehlulelayo; phela wehlulela kuphela empilweni yasemhlabeni”.
Thina sikholelwe eNkosini yethu ukuze isithethelele izimpambuko zethu kanye nalokho kwemilingo osiphoqelele kukho. Futhi u Allah nguyena ongcono noyohlala ekhona.
Nebala, loyo oyofika eNkosini yakhe enecala [lokungakholwa]; uyothola iJahanamu, akayikufa kuyo noma aphile.
Kepha loyo oyofika kuYo engokholwayo enze nezenzo ezinhle; labo bayothola izigaba eziphezulu.
Izivande zaphakade okugeleza ezansi kwazo imifula, bahlale kuzo unaphakade. Lowo umvuzo walowo oziphathe kahle.
Futhi sembulela kuMusa ukuthi: “Hamba nezigqila zami ubasheyele indlela eyomile olwandle, ungesabi ukuficwa [uFirawuni] futhi ungabi novalo [lokuminza].
uFirawuni nebutho lakhe babalandela, kepha bambozwa amanzi lawo amamboza.
uFirawuni wabadukisa abantu bakhe, futhi akabaholelanga endleleni eqondile.
Sizwe sakwa Isirayeli, nebala sanihlenga esitheni senu futhi sanibekela isikhathi sokuhlangana ngasohlangothi lwesokudla entabeni iTuri. Futhi sanehlisela imana nezigwaca.
Dlanini kokumsulwa [okuhlanzekile] esinabele kona futhi ningabe seniphula imithetho kukho, funa nehlelwe ulaka lwaMi. Kantike lowo owehlelwa ulaka lwaMi, impela usuke esebhubhile.
Futhi impela Ngingothethelelayo kulowo ozisolayo bese ekholwa enze izenzo ezinhle azimelele endleleni eqondile.
Musa, yini lena ekwenze usheshe ufike ngaphambi kwabantu bakho na?
Wathi: “Labo basezithendeni zami; ngisheshe ukufika kuWe Nkosi yami ukuze uthokoze”.
Wathi [u Allah]: “Impela sibalingile abantu bakho emuva kokuba usuhambile futhi uSamiri ubadukisile”.

Wabuyela ebantwini bakhe uMusa ecasukile elusizi. Wathi: [Bantu bakithi, ingabe iNkosi yenu ayizange yini inithembise isithembiso esihle na? Ingabe sibe side isikhathi kini [nadineka] noma nifune ukuba nehlelwe ulaka oluvela eNkosini yenu, kungakho ningasigcinanga isivumelwano sami na?
Bathi: “Asisiphulanga isivumelwano sakho ngokwethu. Kepha sithweswe imigodla bobucwebe babantu [bakaFirawuni] sayintshinga [emlilweni]. Kanjalo noSamiri waphonsela phakathi [ayekuphethe]”.
Wabakhiqizela umzimba wethole owawubhongisa okwenkomo, base bethi: “Nguye lona okumele nimkhonza nina noMusa kepha wakhohlwa”.
Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi alikwazi ukubaphendula futhi alikwazi ukubalimaza noma ukubazuzisa ngalutho.
Futhi uHaruni wayekade ethe kubo phambilini: “Bantu bakithi, niyalingwa ngalo [ithole]. Impela iNkosi yenu ngoNomusa. Ngakhoke landelani mina futhi nilalele imiyalelo yami”.
Bathi: “Siyolokhu sihleli kulo silindile kuze uyabuya kithi uMusa”.
Wathi [uMusa]: “Haruni, lapho ubabona beduka, yini ekuvimbile...?”
Ekutheni ungilandele, ingabe nawe wephule umyalelo wami na?
Wathi [uHaruni]: “Mtakamama, musa ungidonsa ngetshebe yami nangekhanda lami. Ngisabe ukuthi uzothi: - uhlakaze isizwe sakwa Isirayeli futhi wangawagcina amazwi ami”.
Wathi [uMusa]: “Yini ngawe weSamiri?”
Wathi: “Ngibone abangakubonanga, ngase ngicaphuna ezinyathelweni zeSithunywa ngakuthela [ebucwebeni obebushiswa]. Ungiyenge kanjalo umphefumulo wami”.

Wathi [uMusa]: “Hamba, ngokuba empilweni yakho kuyomele uthi – ‘ningangithinti’ – futhi unesikhathi sakho ongeke waphuthiswa sona [kwelizayo]. Futhi buka lesi sikhonzwa sakho obuzinze kuso, sizosishisa bese sisifaza emanzini”.
Impela okunguyena enimele nimkhonze ngu Allah kuphela, Lona okungafanele kukhonzwe okunye ngaphandle kwaKhe. Ulwazi lwaKhe lwengamele yonke into.
Sikulandisela kanjalo izindaba zalokho osekwandlula. Futhi sikuphe isikhumbuzo esivela kithi [iKurani].
Lowo oyishaya indiva, uyothwala icala ngoSuku lokwahlulela.
Uyohlala kuso [isijeziso] unaphakade. Waze wamubi umthwalo wabo ngoSuku lokwahlulela.
Ngosuku lapho kuyoshaywa icilongo; siyobuthanisa abanamacala ngalolo suku beluhlaza [isibhakabhaka].
Bayokhulumela phansi phakathi kwabo [bathi]: “Nihlale [izinsuku] eziyishumi kuphela”.
Thina sikwazi kahle lokho abakushoyo lapho ethi lowo ongathi ukhaliphile kubo: “Cha, nihlale nje usuku kuphela”.
Futhi bakubuza ngezintaba. Yithi: “iNkosi yami iyoziphushula zibe impuqumpuqu”.
Uyowushiya [umhlaba] uyithafa eliyisicaba elibushelelezi.
Angeke ubone kugwemba noma ukuba magwici kuwo.
Ngalolo suku bayolandela isigijimi esingenakugwemba. Futhi amazwi ayomthulela Onomusa, ngeke uzwe lutho ngaphandle nje kokuhlebezela.
Ngalolo suku akukho kushweleza okuyoba usizo, ngaphandle okwalowo oyovunyelwa Onomusa aphinde akuthakasele ukuba akhulume.
Wazi konke okungaphambi kwabo [okuzayo] nokusemuva kwabo [okwendlule], kepha bona abasoze bazi konke ngaYe.
Ubuso nobuso buyomthobela Ophilayo Ongumnakekeli. Futhi lowo oyobe ethwele impambuko [ukungakholwa] akasoze aphumelela.
Futhi lowo owenza izenze ezinhle ebe engokholwayo, akayikuwesaba okungekona ubulungiswa noma ukuncishiselwa [umvuzo].
Siyembulele kanjalo iyiKurani yesi Arabhu sacacisa kuyo ezinye zezijeziso, hlele bapheze noma ibakhumbuze ngandlela thize.
Makaphakanyiswe uAllah, iNkosi yeQiniso. Ungajahi ukufunda iKurani kungaphothulwa ukuyembulela kuwe [Muhamadi]. Futhi yithi:”Nkosi yami ngandisele ulwazi”.
Impela senza isivumelwano no Adamu phambilini. Kepha wakhohlwa futhi asimtholanga enokuzimisela.
Khumbula mhla sithi kuzingelosi: “Khothamelani u Adamu niwe ngobuso; zakhothama ngaphandle kuka Ibilisi, yena wala”.
Sathi: “Adamu, nebala lona isitha sakho nomkakho; makanganikhiphi-ke eJana funa nisokole”.
Ngokuba awusoze walamba noma uhambaze kuyo.
Futhi awusoze wonywa noma ushiswe yilanga kuyo.
uShayitani wamhlebela wathi: “Adamu, kunganjani ngikukhombise isihlahla saphakade nobukhosi obungapheli na?”
Badla kuso [isihlahla] babanqunu, baqala ukuzimboza ngamacembe aseJana. U Adamu wawuphula umyalelo weNkosi yakhe waphambuka.
Emuva kwalokho yamqoka iNkosi yakhe yamthethelela yamholela endleleni eqondile.

Wathi [u Allah]: “Yehlani kuyo nonke; abanye benu bayoba izitha kwabanye. Ngakhoke uma kufika kini ukukhanya okuvela kiMi; lowo oyolandela ukukhanya kwaMi angeke aduka futhi angeke abe nesiphetho esibi.
Kepha lowo ofulathela isikhumbuzo saMi; uyoba nempilo enzima. Futhi siyomvusa ngoSuku lokwahlulela eyimpumputhe.
Uyothi: “Kungani ungivuse ngingaboni na, ngibe bengibona [phambilini] na?”
Uyothi [u Allah]: “Kanjalo yafika kuwe imibiko yeThu kepha wayingayinaka. Kanjalo-ke nawe namhlanje awuyikunakwa”.
Simjezisa kanjalo lowo ophula umthetho ebe engakholwa imibiko yeNkosi yakhe. Futhi isijeziso sakwelizayo sinzima futhi sihlala sikhona.
Ingabe ababonanga yini ukuthi maningi kanjani abezinye izizwe abahamba ezindaweni zabo esababhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo. Impela kulokho kunezibonakaliso kulabo abakhaliphile.
Ukube bekungesiso isinqumo esibekiwe esivela eNkosini yakho [sokudondisa isijeziso] nesikhathi esibekiwe, besizobehlela [isijeziso besasemhlabeni].

Ngakho-ke kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo ubabaze udumo lweNkosi yakho ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga nangaphambi kokuba lishone. Nangezikhathi zakusihlwa, mbabaze. Nasemaphethelweni emini hleze uthokoze.

Futhi amehlo mawangalangezeleli lokho esikwabele labo abafana nabo [abangakholwa], okungubukhazikhazi bempilo yasemhlabeni ukuze sibavivinye ngakho. Futhi isabelo seNkosi yakho singcono futhi sihlala sikhona.
Yalela umndeni wakho ngeswala ubambelele kuyo. Asikuceli sondlo; yithina esikondlayo. Futhi isiphetho esalabo abathobela u Allah.
Bathi: “Kungani engasiletheli isibonakaliso esivela eNkosi yakhe na?” Abuzange yini bufike kubo ubufakazi obabuqukethwe iMibhalo yasendulo na?
Ukube sababhubhisa ngesijeziso ngaphambi kwaso [iSithunywa], bebezothi: “Nkosi yethu, okungenani ngabe uthumele iSithunywa kithi ukuze silandele imibiko yaKho anduba siphoxeke noma sihlazeke”.
Yithi: “Bonke balindele, ngakhoke nani lindani, kungekudala niyokwazi ukuthi ngobani abasendleleni eqondile nalabala abasekukhanyeni”.
